sections.description: Answer in one or two sentences or evaluate the code output.

questions.q: What is Title Casing (or Initial Capping) in ICSE Board exam questions?
questions.answer: Title Casing is the formatting convention where the first character of each word in a sentence is capitalized, while all subsequent letters of each word are in lowercase (e.g. "java is great" becomes "Java Is Great").

questions.q: Write a statement to convert character 'ch' from lowercase to uppercase using ASCII arithmetic without using Character.toUpperCase().
questions.answer:
```java
ch = (char)(ch - 32);
```
Because ASCII 'A' (65) is 32 units lower than 'a' (97).

Output: `"Intelligent"`
Explanation: First character "i" becomes "I", concatenated with substring from index 1 ("ntelligent").

questions.q: How does reversing each word of a sentence differ from reversing the entire sentence?
questions.answer: Reversing each word preserves word sequence while flipping the characters of each word ("BLUE J" -> "EULB J"). Reversing the entire sentence flips both characters and word positions ("BLUE J" -> "J EULB").
questions.hint: Preserving word order vs flipping the entire string.

questions.q: What logic converts an entire string to Toggle Case (lowercase becomes uppercase, uppercase becomes lowercase)?
questions.answer: Iterate through characters: if `Character.isUpperCase(ch)`, convert via `Character.toLowerCase(ch)`; else if `Character.isLowerCase(ch)`, convert via `Character.toUpperCase(ch)`. Non-alphabets remain unchanged.
questions.hint: Invert the case of each character individually.
